structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask the bank and my son. The page told me money in the עו"ש earns nothing and that the bank should notify me above 15,000 ₪, but it gave no actual cost, and the red warnings about no deposit insurance scared me off doing anything based on a private site.
